mechanism: Independently authored Python three-action local-cell colony with distinct per-action fast/slow plasticity, state-local ring messages and selected-action-only signed public progress/outcome feedback; not Wingless fast/slow Q-update nor a delegated conventional BFS policy.
method: Per-action ten local cells (9 public features plus bias response) adapt from real public after-step reward and geometric progress. Chosen-action-only bounded local prediction-error plasticity; slow per-cell consolidation 0.95 slow+0.05 fast; ring interactions counted. No bootstrap or copied Wingless weights. SHA checkpoint.
public_information: Pure public MiniGrid FullyObsWrapper image-derived x,y,direction,goal coords,front-blocked; no source seed, hidden grid, oracle goal path, BFS or trained weights imported from Wingless.
focus_test: PYTHONPATH=. python -B -m unittest discover -s research/native/itd02/r1 -p test_native_policy.py -v
gates: A real native policy returns an integer in {0,1,2} from current public observation and its own learned local state
Original native interface accepts chosen action2 as both prediction and consequence-learning input
Real after-step consequence update changes genuinely learned state; no hidden label or future outcome accessible during choose
Cold serialized checkpoint authenticates version/schema/digest and restores exact native predictions in a fresh process or instance
Invalid action, invalid or nonfinite public sensor/reward, stale checkpoint or tampering fail closed without mutating state
Demonstrate all three candidate decisions are reachable with independently generated public training examples, no hard-coded expert path or output mapping
Focused original repo source-only native tests and own GitHub hosted CI must pass; no MiniGrid CHECK or DEV trial, no science admission
scientific_metrics_future: Independent preregistration before FIT and DEV in FORGE with *new* seed families and equal experienced observations/actions/consequences; strong BFS, tabular Q, recurrent, simple count, random; cold restart retention, interference and public action learning, CPU/RSS/snapshot/resource accounting.
